# Logistic Regression

## Running the regression
```{r}
logistic_model <- logistic_reg() %>%
        set_engine("glm") %>%
        set_mode("classification") %>% 
        fit(ever_depression ~ ., data = train_data)
```


## Use trained model on test data
```{r}
pred_class <- predict(logistic_model,
                      new_data = test_data,
                      type = "class")

table(pred_class$.pred_class)
```


### Observed counts in outcome (test data)
```{r}
table(test_data$ever_depression)
```


### Generate predicted probabilities
```{r}
pred_prob <- predict(logistic_model,
                      new_data = test_data,
                      type = "prob")
head(pred_prob)
```

### Compare predicted probabilities to observed class
```{r}
diabetes_results <- test_data %>%
  select(ever_depression) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_class, pred_prob)

head(diabetes_results)
```

## Model Evaluation
### Confusion matrix
```{r}
conf_mat(diabetes_results, truth = ever_depression,
         estimate = .pred_class)
```

### Accuracy
```{r}
accuracy(diabetes_results, truth = ever_depression,
         estimate = .pred_class)
```

### Sensitivity
```{r}
sens(diabetes_results, truth = ever_depression,
    estimate = .pred_class)
```

### Specificity
```{r}
spec(diabetes_results, truth = ever_depression,
    estimate = .pred_class)
```

### Precision
```{r}
precision(diabetes_results, truth = ever_depression,
    estimate = .pred_class)
```

### ROC Curve
```{r}
roc_auc(diabetes_results,
        truth = ever_depression,
        .pred_0)

roc_curve <- diabetes_results %>%
  roc_curve(truth = ever_depression, .pred_0) %>%
  autoplot()

plot(roc_curve)
```

### All metrics
```{r}
metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec, precision, recall, f_meas)

all_metrics_lr <- metrics(diabetes_results,
               truth = ever_depression,
               estimate = .pred_class)
               
kable(all_metrics_lr)
```

## Feature importance
```{r}
coeff <- tidy(logistic_model) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

kable(coeff)

ggplot(coeff, aes(x = reorder(term, abs(estimate)), y = estimate, fill = estimate > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato", "steelblue"),
                    labels = c("Decrease", "Increase"),
                    name   = "Odds person with DM has depression") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Most Important Features — Logistic Regression",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Coefficient Estimate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
